about.title: About Catequese Viva
about.intro: A complete pastoral platform for Christian initiation, connecting dioceses, parishes, catechists, families, and catechumens in an integrated faith journey.
about.mission_text: To facilitate and strengthen the catechetical mission of the Catholic Church, offering modern tools that enable coordinators, catechists, and families to accompany Christian formation with excellence, simplicity, and security.

offers.classes: Class and catechist management — organize classes by stage, catechetical year, and community.
offers.attendance: Attendance tracking — record presence, absences, and justifications with ease.
offers.sacraments: Sacramental accompaniment — configure personalized sacramental journeys.
offers.content: Content library — create, review, and publish meeting plans.
offers.communication: Pastoral communication — send segmented messages to families and catechists.
offers.reports: Reports and indicators — track catechesis health with KPIs.

pricing.title: Choose the right plan for your pastoral routine
pricing.subtitle: Two clear plans. Single covers one catechist; Unlimited covers the parish or diocesan operation.

plan_desc.single: For one catechist to run a class with clarity, history, and preparation in one flow.
plan_desc.unlimited: For parishes and dioceses to centralize teams, classes, families, and AI in one system.

faq.q: How can I evaluate the platform before subscribing?
faq.a: You can start on the catechist path, understand the platform structure, and move to the plan that fits you when you decide to prepare meetings more consistently.
Single includes 15 AI credits per month. Unlimited includes 50 AI credits per month. A meeting or activity uses 1 credit; annual planning uses 3 credits.

faq.q: What is the difference between Single and Unlimited?
faq.a: Single covers 1 parish, 1 class, and up to 150 catechumens for one catechist. Unlimited removes the operational limits and is designed for parish and diocesan routines.
We accept credit card (one-time or monthly). On the annual plan, payment is a single charge for 12 months. No commitment — cancel anytime.
Annual plans have no automatic refund. Cancellation stops renewal, but access continues until the paid period ends. Proportional refunds are evaluated case by case via contato@catequeseviva.com.br.
